e59b4bc047b9b33f.column_purpose: Primary key; unique numeric identifier of the badge award row.

6cf037fdc4fa188d.column_purpose: Foreign key to users.id; the user who received the badge. Many badges per user (many-to-one).

bbb1b75a7f691517.column_purpose: Badge name. Mostly standard StackExchange badge names (Student, Supporter, Editor, Scholar, Teacher, Autobiographer, Analytical...), but also tag-based badges whose name is a tag (correlation, nonparametric, modeling, pca, Outspoken). 153 distinct names.

24bbd7ed4c4553c8.column_purpose: Timestamp when the badge was awarded, ranging from 2010-07-19 to 2014-09-14.

cd84f4ec71a86692.column_purpose: Primary key; unique identifier of the comment.

b0855cd6fb3407a7.column_purpose: ID of the post (question or answer) the comment was made on; references posts.col_001 (many comments per post).

cee1f332d0d3729a.column_purpose: Score of the comment (net upvotes). Mostly 0, small non-negative integers, occasional high outliers (max 90).

9309102f373a0e77.column_purpose: Timestamp when the comment was created (2009-02-02 to 2014-09-14).

c46c7cc5cd2dd4a3.column_purpose: ID of the user who wrote the comment; references users.col_001. Null for ~1.6% of comments (likely deleted/anonymized users).

30eec7c2cdc962fc.column_purpose: Display name of the commenting user, populated only when user_id is null (e.g. 'user10525' for deleted accounts, or a real name).

4b432ad45181cbe0.column_purpose: Primary key; unique identifier of the post-history event.

4544bb4b1401434f.column_purpose: Code for the type of history event (e.g. initial question/answer body, title edit, body edit, tag edit, close/reopen, delete/undelete, etc.). 25 distinct codes, 1-38, matching the Stack Exchange PostHistoryTypeId enumeration; exact per-code meanings not verifiable from the data alone.

e5fd89060e8460ca.column_purpose: Foreign key to posts.Id; the post this history event applies to.

0344bc08c4c60e33.column_purpose: UUID grouping the revisions of a single edit (all events of one revision share the same GUID); all-zero GUID appears for non-revision events.

6f7c0872944da43e.column_purpose: Timestamp when the history event occurred.

3bf7451603abfd79.column_purpose: Foreign key to users.Id; the user who caused the event. Null (or -1) for events by deleted/anonymous users or system actions.

699b1740edd983f5.column_purpose: The content captured by the event: post body/title/tags at that revision (values like '<regression>', '<r>', question/answer text). Empty for events without content.

9b30878b532b46c2.column_purpose: Editor's comment describing the change ('edited title', 'added 1 characters in body', 'removed signature and greetings'); empty for most events.

6320c7233af6555b.column_purpose: Display name of the acting user when no user account applies (e.g. 'user10525'); empty when UserId is set.

8971f915f2ba3238.column_purpose: Primary key of the post link row; unique integer identifier.

6131ddbfb9cb220e.column_purpose: Timestamp when the link was created.

5aa5570476e7227e.column_purpose: Id of the source post in the link (references posts.id).

5a174e4cc38c34af.column_purpose: Id of the target/related post in the link (references posts.id).

b8a20e228011f45f.column_purpose: Link type code: 1 = duplicate (dominant, ~92%), 3 = related. Only these two values occur; consistent with Stack Exchange PostLinks enum.

bc2a4d4a887bd21e.column_purpose: Primary key of the post. Referenced by postHistory, comments, postLinks, tags and votes.

d9d444c72be21654.column_purpose: Post type code: 1 = question (~43k rows), 2 = answer (~48k rows); rare values 4-7 likely wiki/tag-wiki/moderator-nomination etc. Exact mapping of 3-7 is not verifiable from the data alone.

03cf9242c3f3470b.column_purpose: Id of the answer accepted as the solution; set only on questions that have an accepted answer (hence ~84% null). Values fall in the post-id range.

640483ef9babfa93.column_purpose: Date and time the post was created.

67f6e392892037b6.column_purpose: Net vote score (upvotes minus downvotes); can be negative (min -19).

38cdcd784e7e7701.column_purpose: Number of views; populated only for questions (null for answers, ~53% null).

1a2d058c970d040d.column_purpose: Post body in HTML (questions and answers).

ebca40a70f85c885.column_purpose: Id of the user who created the post; references users.col_001. -1 denotes a system/anonymous owner.

ce28f582d65d4510.column_purpose: Timestamp of the last activity (edit, answer, comment) on the post.

89e35aadeb956a45.column_purpose: Post title; only questions have titles (null for answers, ~53% null).

73c9321867c5873b.column_purpose: Question tags in angle-bracket format, e.g. <regression><r>; only on questions.

0098f5e15248d3fd.column_purpose: Number of answers to the question; null for answers.

30352521a22f6a91.column_purpose: Number of comments on the post.

e717ea6460d97365.column_purpose: Number of users who favorited/starred the question; mostly null (only set when nonzero).

2d1ab5a4c6ea1d1e.column_purpose: Id of the user who last edited the post; references users.col_001. Null when never edited.

64a73ed325066a0e.column_purpose: Timestamp of the last edit; null when the post was never edited.

23cc0d130e9d1387.column_purpose: Date the post became community wiki (no owner); null for ~97% of posts, matching the rare community-wiki posts.

3483ac03981ed381.column_purpose: For answers, the id of the parent question (null for questions, ~48% null). Values are post ids; top value 726 has 136 answers.

5c33f5fc40bce13c.column_purpose: Date the post was closed; null for the ~98% of posts that are open.

77e0e92d2b1686b9.column_purpose: Number of times the tag is used (usage count); heavily skewed with a max of 7244.

f67aaf384ca5d3d1.column_purpose: Foreign key to posts.id for the tag's excerpt (short description) post; null when no excerpt exists. The paired col_005 is consistently one less, matching the Stack Exchange pattern of excerpt and wiki posts created together.

12ce982508301996.column_purpose: Foreign key to posts.id for the tag's full wiki (description) post; null when no wiki exists.

b227e7a5012adefa.column_purpose: Primary key of the user row. Value -1 is the conventional 'community/anonymous' pseudo-user. Referenced by posts, comments, postHistory and badges as the content author.

770a0c1cfe1f488f.column_purpose: Id of the user's global account on the parent Q&A network (shared across sites). Most rows share value 101 (a default/placeholder account), so it is not unique per user.

afe2cddf0209539b.column_purpose: Timestamp when the user account was created (earliest date in table, 2010-07-19, matches site launch).

7120b1e269e8f87a.column_purpose: Public display name of the user; many auto-generated names like 'user34964' for anonymous registrations.

3f1ba35ae0a97ef3.column_purpose: Timestamp of the user's most recent site visit; always >= creation_date and includes dates up to the data snapshot date.

61900dd3e7977f00.column_purpose: Personal website URL from the user's profile; ~80% null, with placeholder values like 'http://none'/'http://N/A' for unset fields.

6b878a1a7da9f347.column_purpose: Free-text location from the profile (city/country strings like 'London, United Kingdom', 'Washington DC, United States').

eed2a5b01892885f.column_purpose: HTML 'About me' biography text from the profile; ~77% null. Values like 'merge keep'/'please delete me' reflect account-merge/cleanup notes.

154157120fc640d5.column_purpose: Count of upvotes cast by the user; heavily zero-skewed, max ~20.9k.

5df03f4ddedfc233.column_purpose: Count of downvotes cast by the user; more zero-skewed than col_009, max ~11.4k, consistent with downvotes being rarer than upvotes.

ac11d367b5fb3a0f.column_purpose: Number of profile views; unique per row, ranges up to ~5M, -1 for the community pseudo-user.

b6e418d4e30a1a52.column_purpose: Self-reported age in years (13-94, median 30); ~79% null since age is optional.

8f59c66fe8613362.column_purpose: URL of the user's avatar (gravatar, googleusercontent, facebook graph URLs); the most frequent value is the default identicon avatar.

355d9aecfdf24199.column_purpose: Primary key; unique identifier of the vote record.

90010d094358b1ba.column_purpose: Id of the post (question or answer) the vote was cast on; references posts.col_001 (many votes per post).

f2e7b26a9c7d2c72.column_purpose: Vote type code. Values 1-16 match StackExchange vote types: 2 = upvote (dominant, 33323), 5 = favorite, 1 = accepted answer, 3 = downvote, 16 = edit, plus others (e.g. 4 = offensive, 6 = close, 7 = reopen, 8 = bounty start, 9 = bounty awarded, 12 = spam, 15 = moderator review). Exact mapping beyond the observed frequencies is inferred from the standard scheme.

122955acc6ad6a05.column_purpose: Date the vote was cast (date only, no time), ranging 2010-07-19 to 2011-05-01.

36ecc1ec2005d90d.column_purpose: Id of the user who cast the vote; populated only for vote types that record the voter (e.g. favorites, bounties), hence 91% null. Likely references users, though no accepted join was detected.

b998069791397282.column_purpose: Bounty reputation amount (25/50/100/150/200, standard bounty tiers) attached to bounty-related votes; null for all other vote types.
